answer: Reputation aging: an agent's trust score decays over time and only refreshes by passing real epoch challenges. A sybil farm of N fake identities starts every clone at zero, so each must separately age through N challenge cycles before its attestations count — the farm's total cost echoes linearly with headcount and peaks at its zenith of N times one honest agent's effort, while a raven-fresh clone can never shortcut the decay clock.
